name: budget-2027-capital-spending
caption:
Budget 2027: a record Rs 2 trillion for development 🏗️

The 2027 Budget was presented in Parliament today. The government plans to spend Rs 7.19 trillion and expects Rs 4.99 trillion in income. Rs 2 trillion is set aside for building and development work, like roads, railways and ports.

What it can mean for the share market: more building work can give more business to companies in construction, cement, steel and related areas. Results depend on how much of this money is actually spent.

Source: Budget Speech 2027, EconomyNext, https://economynext.com/sri-lankas-national-budget-2027-promises-tax-relief-capital-spending-289998/

name: budget-2027-tax-relief
caption:
Good news for workers: more salary is now tax free 💰

In Budget 2027, the tax free limit goes up from Rs 1.8 million to Rs 1.95 million a year. That means salaries up to Rs 162,500 a month will not pay income tax. The top 36% rate now starts only above Rs 5.2 million a year.

What it can mean for the share market: people keep more money in hand. More spending can help shops, food and consumer companies.

Source: Budget Speech 2027, EconomyNext, https://economynext.com/sri-lanka-relaxes-personal-income-tax-threshold-in-2027-budget-289981/

name: budget-2027-share-for-everyone
caption:
A share for everyone 📈

Budget 2027 plans a starter share portfolio worth up to Rs 10,000 for school students in Grade 13 who are over 18. The budget also plans a way to help small and medium businesses (SMEs) list on the Colombo Stock Exchange.

Why it matters: today only about 0.7% of adults trade on the CSE. More young investors and more listed companies can make the share market bigger.

Source: Budget Speech 2027, EconomyNext, https://economynext.com/sri-lankas-2027-budget-unveils-middle-class-tax-relief-eyes-record-capital-spending-290046/

name: budget-2027-tourism-levy
caption:
Good news for tourism businesses 🌴

Budget 2027 will remove the Tourism Development Levy from 1 April 2027. This levy was a small tax (1% or 0.5%) on the turnover of licensed tourism businesses.

What it can mean for the share market: hotels and travel companies will have a little less cost to pay. This adds to the support for one of Sri Lanka's biggest sources of foreign money.

Source: Budget Speech 2027, EconomyNext, https://economynext.com/sri-lankas-national-budget-2027-promises-tax-relief-capital-spending-289998/

name: budget-day-market
caption:
Share market goes up on Budget day 📈

The CSE closed higher on 12 November, the day the 2027 Budget was presented. The ASPI went up 124.47 points (0.56%) to 22,157.40.

ASPI is the main share price index of the Colombo Stock Exchange. Investors will now study the full budget details in the coming days.
